locale.description: Locale code of this catalog; selects plural rules. Do not translate.

extDescription.message: Listening history from music web players in your VEINMusic account.

clientName.description: Device name sent to the server during pairing; shown on the VEIN website.

popup_privacyNote.message: Track, artist, artwork, link and playback time are sent.

popup_pairIntro.message: Confirm this device on the VEIN website. No password needed.

popup_pairHint.description: Popup: shown while sending is off.

popup_pairCodeLabel.description: Popup: label above the pairing code.

popup_pairWaiting.message: Waiting for confirmation on the website…

popup_pairDenied.message: Connection was declined on the website.

popup_pairExpired.message: The code has expired. Please try again.

popup_apiKeySummary.description: Popup: collapsible manual API key section.

popup_apiKeyLabel.description: Popup: API key field accessible name.

popup_usernameLabel.description: Popup: username field name and placeholder.

popup_deliveryEmpty.message: Play a track in a music tab. The delivery result will appear here.

popup_testNeedAccount.description: Popup: connection test without an account.

popup_testHttpError.description: Popup: connection test failed with an HTTP status.

popup_hintLater.description: Popup: hint after other HTTP errors.

error_invalidApiUrl.description: Pairing error: API URL not allowed.

error_invalidVerificationPage.message: The server returned an invalid confirmation page

delivery_ok.message: Event received. Whether it counts as a listen depends on the time actually played.

delivery_confirmed_duplicate.message: Event received: this track is already tracked by another connection.

delivery_integration_paused.message: Receiving from this service is turned off in VEIN settings.

delivery_source_ignored.message: This service is excluded from recording in VEIN settings.

delivery_artist_ignored.message: This artist is excluded from recording in VEIN settings.

delivery_track_ignored.message: This track is excluded from recording in VEIN settings.

delivery_short_track_ignored.message: Short tracks are excluded in VEIN settings.

delivery_private_session.message: A private session is on in VEIN: recording is paused.

delivery_blacklisted.message: The event was rejected by VEIN rules.

delivery_link_ignored.message: A link was found in the title or artist.

delivery_rate_limited.message: The server asked to wait. Sending will retry automatically.

delivery_ignored_spam_protection.message: The server postponed the track change. Sending will retry automatically.

delivery_flagged.message: The server limited receiving. Check the integration diagnostics in VEIN.

delivery_ignored_inactive.message: A stopped tab was skipped: music is playing in another player.

delivery_auth_required.message: The key is invalid or has no access. Connect the extension again.

delivery_invalid_payload.message: The service sent incomplete track data. Update the extension and reload the player page.

delivery_network_error.message: No connection to VEIN. The current state will be sent again.

delivery_server_error.message: VEIN is temporarily unavailable. Sending will retry automatically.

delivery_invalid_response.message: The server did not confirm the event. Sending will retry automatically.
